title: Inlet Beach "Barefoot Blue" 98 N. Winston Lane
h1: Inlet Beach "Barefoot Blue" 98 N. Winston Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 3 to 5-minute walk to beach- Private pool - Adjacent to the Rosemary Beach racquet club- Steps away from local shopping and dining at Rosemary Beach and along 30Ave- Multiple balconies with outdoor dining- Premium Wi-Fi with extenders on every floor- 6 adult bikes- 2 gas grills- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Barefoot Blue (formally Villa Cayman) is a beautiful 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home boasting 4 bedrooms, a double bunk room, and 1 sleeper sofa with room for 14 people. It's perfectly situated between Inlet and Rosemary Beach, just a short walk from upscale boutiques and restaurants. The private courtyard features a pool and grill area. Simply put, the name "Barefoot Blue" says a lot!Guests will enjoy the well-equipped chef's kitchen offering stainless steel appliances, designer quartz countertops, ample storage space, plenty of small appliances for the chef, and a coffee machine and complimentary ground coffee for brewing single pods or large carafe. The nearby counter height island-dining table seats 6. Neutral soothing tones, blue accents, artwork, and plush furnishings create a tranquil ambiance in the living room, which seats 6. Additional seating on the patio allows for a wonderful vacation.On the second floor, you will find 2 guest rooms featuring a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo in one and an oversized walk-in shower in the other. The bunk room has 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds offering a cozy getaway with its own TV.The third floor has a primary king suite, both offering a shower and separate soaking tub. Each floor offers a large balcony that can be accessed from all bedrooms and provides seating and privacy with beautiful views of the pool and trees. The outdoor oasis boasts a sparkling, private pool with a sunning bay surrounded by chaise lounge chairs and an outdoor dining set. There is plenty of seating for the entire party of 12. Take a 5-minute walk to the sugar-white sand beach and sparkling emerald waters just minutes by foot, or to the local shops and dining in the center of Rosemary Beach. 6 adult beach cruiser bikes provide a great way to see the sights in our wonderful 30A coastal towns. Barefoot Blue is the perfect place for your next coastal getaway. Book your stay now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunkbeds THIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa*Garage is not for guest use.*Home utilizes smart Tv features and does not have basic cable.
